title: Middle-layer indicator coefficients
statement: For nonnegative integers $m,j$ with $j\le m$, let $T$ be a set of coordinates in a cube of dimension $2m$ with $|T|=2j$. The Fourier coefficient at $T$ of the indicator of inputs having exactly $m$ positive coordinates is $(-1)^j\binom{m}{j}\big/\binom{2m}{2j}\;\cdot\;\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a subset of the $2m$ coordinates
